brief: We screened 1,307 sites and identified 220 actionable cash offer deals along with key faith-based and city-owned opportunities. This week we are prioritizing four top sites across Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx that offer strong headroom and clear execution paths. Our plan combines direct private offers, a faith-owned ground lease joint venture, and local outreach on a high-yield city property.

targets.negotiation: Cap our bid at the max_offer of $784,436 against estimated land cost of $713,124, locking in 2.34x headroom.
targets.risk: Verify site condition and zoning parameters before mailing the offer letter.
